corrected_content.problem:
A body of mass $5kg$ is moving in a straight line along the $x$-axis under the action of a single force $F$, measured in Newtons.
At time $t$ seconds, the velocity of the body is given by $v(t) = t^{3} - 2e^{t}$ meters per second.
Find an expression for the force acting on the body at time $t$.
corrected_content.worked_solution: Acceleration is $v'(t)=3t^2-2e^t$. Multiply by the mass $5\,\mathrm{kg}$: $$F(t)=5(3t^2-2e^t)=15t^2-10e^t,$$ measured in newtons.
